title: The Water Is Listening
logline: Nara takes the filament to Soren at Bellwether Waterworks. He demonstrates sampling, protected storage and the difference between disinfection and filtration before finding pressure pulses arriving every seventeen seconds.
narrator_voice: A young woman in her mid-twenties narrating a dark survival story. Low, slightly husky, calm and tired, speaking close to the microphone like a late-night confession. American accent, natural, never theatrical.

characters.name: Nara Venn
characters.tags: young woman, 24, short black bob, fixed white streak at left temple, amber eyes, mustard scarf, charcoal courier jacket, silver triangle ear cuff, black cargo trousers
characters.voice: Low, intimate and direct; short reflective sentences with dry humor and restrained emotion.
characters.bio: A bike courier carrying a copper filament pulled from Calder Row's failing tap water.

characters.name: Jun Arai
characters.tags: teenage girl, 17, feminine face, chin-length dense auburn curls, teal over-ear headphones around neck, yellow rain shell, narrow black gloves, analog wristwatch
characters.voice: Quick, precise and slightly breathless; technical ideas translated into simple comparisons.
characters.bio: An electronics apprentice whose magnet exposed the conductive filament in Nara's stored water.

characters.name: Soren Malik
characters.tags: man, 31, long dark braid, orange knit cap, gray waterworks coverall, heavy rubber boots, steel sampling flask
characters.voice: Calm baritone with careful pauses; explains survival processes without sounding like a lecture.
characters.bio: A municipal water operator who tests failing systems carefully and refuses to call clear water safe without evidence.

negative: No gore, zombies, corpses, fantasy magic, comedy exaggeration, sexualization, embedded captions, episode titles, watermarks, logos, or readable text except specified prop labels. No cropped faces, inconsistent clothing, extra limbs, malformed hands, or changing backgrounds between poses.
look: Cinematic rain-dark seinen anime, hand-painted industrial backgrounds, green ceramic tunnels, rust-red valves, reflective tile, copper highlights, restrained expressions, realistic water and glass, moody practical lighting, consistent character designs.
music: Five-minute dark ambient survival score: deep low drones, distant metallic textures, faint rain, almost no melody, slow heavy tension that sits quietly under narration. Five-minute instrumental tension score with low bowed strings, muted analog synth pulses, sparse water-drop percussion and metallic pipe resonance. Begin with an urgent seventeen-second motif, thin out during the sampling lesson, add ticking tension as the filament moves, then build through synchronized gauge strikes into a cold unresolved bass note at the Line Nine reveal. No vocals.

shots.framing: Low wide shot showing all three faces, six enormous gauges and a glass sample in the foreground
shots.background: Green ceramic pressure gallery, six aligned gauge needles, rust-red valve wheels and a copper filament suspended in the foreground glass
poses: Nara stares at the gauges, Jun grips her headphones, and Soren braces both hands on the console.
Nara leans toward the glass, Jun raises one gloved finger, and Soren watches the needles with a tightened jaw.
Nara turns sharply toward Soren, Jun checks her watch, and Soren points across the row of gauges.
Nara stands rigid, Jun holds her breath, and Soren lowers his hand with a grave expression.
shots.narration: Every seventeen seconds, Meridian's water answered something beneath us.
shots.sfx: Deep pipe thump, six simultaneous gauge ticks, faint glass vibration

shots.framing: Wide street-level establishing shot with all three faces visible near the waterworks gate
shots.background: Rain-dark municipal waterworks, elevated pipes, lit city blocks, crawling traffic and one darkened intersection
poses: Nara carries the sealed jar, Jun walks close beside her, and Soren waits beneath the gate canopy.
Nara raises the jar slightly, Jun scans the building, and Soren studies them from beneath his orange cap.
Nara steps toward the gate, Jun checks her analog watch, and Soren gestures them inside.
Nara looks back at the faltering city lights, Jun follows her gaze, and Soren holds the gate open.
shots.narration: At 7:17, the Hum sounded three seconds from every Meridian phone and speaker; Meridian stood, but taps faltered as we reached Bellwether for answers.
shots.sfx: Hard rain, distant traffic, uneven pump rumble, electrical transformer buzz

shots.framing: Medium three-shot across a tiled laboratory counter, with every face fully visible
shots.background: Tiled sampling laboratory, stainless sink, sealed bottles, analog wall clock and the jar centered on the counter
poses: Nara presents the jar carefully, Jun holds the magnet near her chest, and Soren studies the filament.
Nara keeps both hands steady, Jun leans forward, and Soren reaches for clean gloves.
Nara watches Soren, Jun narrows her eyes at the jar, and Soren points toward an empty sample tray.
Nara lowers the jar onto the tray, Jun pulls her magnet back, and Soren raises a warning palm.
shots.narration: Our filament twitched near a magnet. Soren had one pressure window to decide whether our water was safe.

line.text: Bring the jar. Don't shake it.

shots.sfx: Ventilation hum, distant pipe knock, glass touching metal tray

shots.framing: Eye-level medium shot across the sampling bench with all three faces visible
shots.background: Sterile bottles, steel instruments, green wall tiles and a narrow window overlooking operating pumps
poses: Soren holds the clear jar at eye level while Nara and Jun watch from opposite sides.
Soren tilts his head toward the light, Nara folds her arms, and Jun peers through the water.
Soren lowers the jar, Nara looks unconvinced, and Jun presses her lips into a doubtful line.
Soren gestures toward the equipment, Nara follows his hand, and Jun straightens attentively.
shots.narration: Soren Malik ran Bellwether's samples while the city kept pretending its pipes were ordinary.

line.text: Clear only means you can see through it.

shots.sfx: Steady pump vibration, soft glass clink, rain against narrow window

shots.framing: Medium side view of Soren at the bench with Nara and Jun fully framed behind him
shots.background: Clean sampling tray, sterile bottle, wrapped cap and stainless handwashing sink
poses: Soren holds the sterile bottle away from his coverall while Nara and Jun watch his hands.
Soren raises the untouched cap, Nara leans closer, and Jun keeps both gloved hands behind her back.
Soren steadies the bottle, Nara watches the rim, and Jun nods at his careful grip.
Soren positions the bottle beside the jar, Nara relaxes her shoulders, and Jun studies the cap interior.
shots.narration: He washed his hands, opened a sterile bottle, and never touched its mouth or cap interior.

line.text: Contaminate the sample, contaminate the answer.

shots.sfx: Running sink water, glove snap, sterile wrapper rustle

shots.framing: Medium frontal shot of the three around two sample bottles
shots.background: Two capped bottles, grease pencil, sample log and the original glass jar on a white tray
poses: Jun raises one skeptical eyebrow while Soren writes and Nara watches the bottles.
Jun gestures toward the identical samples, Soren keeps writing, and Nara compares their contents.
Jun folds her arms, Soren taps the sample log, and Nara gives Jun a dry sideways glance.
Jun lowers her hands, Soren presents the finished entries, and Nara nods once.
shots.narration: Jun called it fussy. Soren split our jar and marked source, time, and treatment before the samples became guesses.
shots.sfx: Grease pencil scratching, bottle caps clicking, low pipe resonance

shots.framing: Medium shot facing an open storage cabinet, with all three faces fully visible
shots.background: Cool metal cabinet above the floor, dark shelves, sealed sample container and no cleaning chemicals nearby
poses: Soren supports the sealed container while Nara inspects the shelf and Jun looks beneath the cabinet.
Soren points to the tight lid, Nara nods, and Jun checks the cool shaded interior.
Soren holds the container away from the floor, Nara watches his grip, and Jun raises an understanding finger.
Soren slides the container onto the shelf, Nara looks thoughtful, and Jun closes her mouth after starting to object.
shots.narration: He sealed the original cool, dark, and off the floor—protected from new contamination, not magically proven safe.

line.text: A lid protects. It doesn't certify.

shots.sfx: Cabinet hinge creak, seal pressing shut, distant pump cycling

shots.framing: Medium three-shot across a kettle and laboratory filter assembly
shots.background: Steel kettle, rated particulate filter, clear tubing, collection bottle and tiled laboratory wall
poses: Nara rests one hand near the kettle while Soren indicates the filter and Jun watches.
Nara withdraws her hand, Soren holds up the filter cartridge, and Jun leans toward its membrane.
Nara looks from kettle to filter, Soren separates his hands to contrast them, and Jun nods quickly.
Nara grips her scarf thoughtfully, Soren sets the cartridge beside the kettle, and Jun checks the sample tray.
shots.narration: I had planned to boil everything. Soren placed a rated particulate filter beside the kettle.

line.text: Heat kills microbes. It leaves particles behind.

shots.sfx: Kettle element ticking, filter housing twist, soft water gurgle

shots.framing: Tight medium three-shot with every face visible above the magnified sample display
shots.background: Magnification lens, illuminated sample glass, visible copper filament and analog wall clock
poses: Nara freezes over the display, Jun points at the filament, and Soren looks toward the clock.
Nara tracks the filament with narrowed eyes, Jun checks her watch, and Soren counts silently.
Nara turns toward Jun, Jun raises two fingers, and Soren keeps his gaze fixed on the sample.
Nara leans closer, Jun holds the magnet still, and Soren's expression hardens.
shots.narration: But the filament wasn't drifting. It was keeping time.
shots.sfx: Clock tick, faint pipe knock, delicate glass vibration

shots.framing: Medium frontal shot of three samples and all three characters
shots.background: Three identical bottles, kettle, filter assembly, magnet and laboratory timer
poses: Soren sets out three identical unlabeled sample bottles in a row while Nara and Jun compare the bottles.
Soren raises one finger, Nara watches the raw sample, and Jun focuses on the boiled sample.
Soren separates the bottles evenly, Nara points toward the filter, and Jun steadies the magnet.
Soren folds his hands behind the samples, Nara leans in, and Jun prepares to test them.
shots.narration: Soren built three identical tests: raw, boiled, and filtered, each taken from the same jar.
shots.sfx: Bottle bases tapping steel, timer click, filter tubing settling

shots.framing: Medium shot centered on Jun testing the boiled sample, with all faces fully visible
shots.background: Boiled sample beside a cooling kettle, tiny magnet, bright inspection lamp and copper thread visible in the glass
poses: Jun holds the magnet beside the bottle while Nara watches the rising thread and Soren observes calmly.
Jun pulls her chin back, Nara narrows her eyes, and Soren points toward the copper thread.
Jun looks disappointed, Nara glances at the kettle, and Soren keeps both hands on the bench.
Jun lowers the magnet, Nara exhales through her nose, and Soren gives a small confirming nod.
shots.narration: The boiled sample looked unchanged. Under Jun's magnet, its copper thread still lifted from the glass.
shots.sfx: Magnet touching glass, kettle metal contracting, faint filament scrape

shots.framing: Medium three-shot around the filter membrane and collected bottle
shots.background: Used filter membrane holding a copper glint, clear collection bottle, magnet and sealed test tray
poses: Soren holds the membrane up while Nara studies the copper glint and Jun tests the bottle.
Soren points to the trapped particle, Nara leans forward, and Jun watches the still water.
Soren lowers the membrane toward the tray, Nara looks relieved, and Jun remains cautiously focused.
Soren raises a warning finger, Nara's relief fades, and Jun pulls the magnet away.
shots.narration: The filter's membrane caught a copper glint. Its bottle stayed still under the same magnet.

line.text: Particles out. Disinfection still comes next.

shots.sfx: Filter release hiss, membrane tray click, magnet brushing glove

shots.framing: Medium-wide shot with all three faces, a large inlet gauge and high exterior windows
shots.background: Operating pumps, large analog inlet gauge, high windows showing moving buses and a flickering city block
poses: Soren watches the gauge while Nara looks toward the windows and Jun listens to the pipes.
Soren leans toward the falling needle, Nara turns back from the city, and Jun checks her watch.
Soren points at the inlet pipe, Nara steps closer, and Jun presses one headphone cup against the metal.
Soren straightens gravely, Nara studies the gauge, and Jun lowers the headphone cup.
shots.narration: Outside, buses still moved and Bellwether still had power. Inside, the inlet gauge lost pressure without warning.

line.text: Low pressure can pull contamination inward.

shots.sfx: Heavy pump drone, bus brakes outside, gauge mechanism clicking downward

shots.framing: Medium-wide shot of the bypass wheel and isolated gauge with all three faces visible
shots.background: Rust-red bypass wheel, isolated pressure dial, green ceramic walls and locked pump housing
poses: Soren grips the closed valve wheel while Nara watches the dial and Jun holds her watch ready.
Soren releases the wheel, Nara points at the dial, and Jun stares at its needle.
Soren leans toward the gauge, Nara raises her eyebrows, and Jun looks sharply toward him.
Soren folds his arms, Nara keeps watching the needle, and Jun gestures back toward the city inlet.
shots.narration: Soren closed Bellwether's pump bypass. The next pressure kick crossed the isolated dial anyway.
shots.sfx: Valve wheel groan, pump muffling, single hard gauge tick

shots.framing: Medium three-shot beside two gauges, with Jun's watch held at chest height
shots.background: Two analog pressure gauges, wet tile floor, overhead pipes and a stationary maintenance lamp
poses: Jun watches her analog second hand while Nara studies the gauges and Soren counts on his fingers.
Jun raises her eyes at the expected moment, Nara braces, and Soren turns toward the needles.
Jun points to the watch face, Nara looks between both gauges, and Soren presses his lips together.
Jun holds up seventeen with her fingers and watch hand, Nara nods, and Soren looks unsettled.
shots.narration: Jun timed the kicks on her analog watch. Seventeen seconds. Then seventeen again.
shots.sfx: Watch ticking, two synchronized gauge clicks, water moving through buried pipes

shots.framing: Medium shot across the storage tray with all three faces fully framed
shots.background: Flickering ceiling lights, capped samples, operating pump indicators and a closed protected cabinet
poses: Soren tightens a sample cap while Nara steadies the tray and Jun watches the ceiling lights.
Soren checks a seal, Nara looks toward the pumps, and Jun points at the next open bottle.
Soren raises the sealed sample, Nara slides the cabinet tray closer, and Jun lowers her hand.
Soren places the sample on the tray, Nara nods, and Jun watches the flicker with concern.
shots.narration: The lights flickered, but pumps kept running. Soren capped every sample before the next pressure dip could dirty it.
shots.sfx: Fluorescent buzz faltering, bottle cap ratchet, pumps continuing below

shots.framing: Symmetrical wide shot showing all three faces beneath six enormous gauges
shots.background: Six analog gauges with needles kicked to matching angles, green tile, red valves and reflective floor
poses: Nara looks up sharply, Jun freezes over her watch, and Soren stares across the gauge row.
Nara steps toward the console, Jun raises the watch, and Soren points at the matching needles.
Nara turns toward Soren, Jun's eyes widen, and Soren silently counts the interval.
Nara faces the gauges again, Jun lowers her wrist, and Soren's expression becomes grave.
shots.narration: Then all six pressure gauges kicked together.
shots.sfx: Six sharp gauge strikes, deep pressure boom, tile resonance

shots.framing: Medium three-shot around the control desk with all faces fully visible
shots.background: Analog controls, protected samples, pressure charts, dim city grid panel and countdown clock
poses: Nara looks from the samples to the charts, Jun leans toward the controls, and Soren watches the pressure clock.
Nara grips her scarf, Jun points at the charts, and Soren keeps one hand above the shutoff controls.
Nara meets Soren's eyes, Jun straightens decisively, and Soren glances toward the gallery.
Nara pulls a chair toward the desk, Jun raises her pencil, and Soren unfolds the first chart.
shots.narration: We could leave with safer storage, or spend Bellwether's last stable-pressure window tracing what was entering the mains.
shots.sfx: Control relays clicking, distant pump surge, paper charts unfolding

shots.framing: Over-desk medium shot with the transparent maps visible and all three faces in frame
shots.background: Municipal grid sheets, transparent pressure overlays, grease pencils and a row of inlet dials
poses: Soren aligns the overlays, Jun holds her pencil ready, and Nara faces the inlet dials.
Soren pins one map corner, Jun watches his hand, and Nara raises two fingers toward a reading.
Soren checks the alignment, Jun marks the sheet, and Nara keeps her eyes on the gauges.
Soren looks toward Nara, Jun pauses above the map, and Nara prepares to call another number.
shots.narration: Soren laid transparent pressure sheets over the municipal grid. Jun marked each kick while I watched the inlet dials.
shots.sfx: Paper sliding, grease pencil marks, distant synchronized gauge ticks

shots.framing: Medium frontal shot of Nara at the dials with Jun and Soren behind the map table
shots.background: North and east inlet dials, layered municipal maps, marked pressure points and dim control lamps
poses: Nara holds up two fingers, Jun marks the map, and Soren compares both inlet dials.
Nara points toward the east gauge, Jun shifts her pencil south, and Soren leans over the overlay.
Nara watches the needles settle, Jun studies the new mark, and Soren traces between two points.
Nara turns toward the table, Jun taps the repeated sequence, and Soren looks along its direction.
shots.narration: North intake dropped two units. East trunk rose two. The changes canceled, but their direction did not.
shots.sfx: Alternating gauge ticks, pencil scratch, low water hammer

shots.framing: Medium three-shot above a growing line of map marks, with faces fully visible
shots.background: Transparent city grid with evenly spaced grease-pencil marks, pressure charts and an analog clock
poses: Jun points along the marks while Nara follows their path and Soren studies the clock.
Jun draws her finger southward, Nara leans over the map, and Soren compares the pressure chart.
Jun looks up at Soren, Nara keeps one hand beside the straight marks, and Soren shakes his head slightly.
Jun lowers her pencil, Nara straightens uneasily, and Soren points toward the map's lower edge.
shots.narration: Each mark landed farther south, perfectly spaced. Failing pumps wandered; this pressure moved with intent.
shots.sfx: Clock ticking, pencil tapping paper, pipe vibration moving overhead

shots.framing: Medium shot facing Jun beside the polling light, with Nara and Soren fully visible
shots.background: Steady control panel, single polling light, pressure marks, analog watch and wall clock
poses: Jun holds her watch beside the polling light while Nara counts silently and Soren watches the panel.
Jun raises one finger at the interval, Nara looks toward the pressure map, and Soren checks the clock.
Jun points between watch and panel, Nara's expression tightens, and Soren leans closer.
Jun lowers her wrist, Nara faces the map, and Soren folds his arms thoughtfully.
shots.narration: Jun counted our marks against the control system's polling light. Both repeated on the same seventeen-second clock.
shots.sfx: Relay click, watch tick, pressure thump arriving in exact rhythm

shots.framing: Medium-wide shot of the three beside rolled infrastructure maps, all faces visible
shots.background: Old map drawers, rolled transit plans, current water grid overlay and a straight pressure trace
poses: Soren reaches toward a deep map drawer while Nara holds the pressure overlay and Jun watches the trace.
Soren pulls the drawer open, Nara raises the transparent sheet, and Jun shifts closer.
Soren searches the rolled plans, Nara compares the pressure line, and Jun points toward its buried route.
Soren lifts an old transit map, Nara steps toward the table, and Jun clears space for it.
shots.narration: The pulses weren't random contamination. They were traveling through one buried corridor beneath the city's working streets.
shots.sfx: Metal drawer scraping, paper rolls shifting, distant pressure boom

shots.framing: High medium shot over the overlay while keeping all three faces fully in frame
shots.background: Water grid beneath an old subway map, pressure marks forming one ruler-straight route under the abandoned yellow line
poses: Nara holds the overlay in place, Jun points at one straight dark line on the old transit map, and Soren stares at the perfect trace.
Nara follows the line with one finger, Jun looks up in disbelief, and Soren leans closer to the map.
Nara turns toward Jun, Jun keeps her finger on the straight line of the old subway route, and Soren compares the water grid beneath it.
Nara looks toward the room's sealed door, Jun withdraws her hand, and Soren remains fixed on the route.
shots.narration: The pressure trace ignored Bellwether's mains. On the transit overlay, it became a perfect line beneath abandoned Line Nine.

line.text: That's impossible. Line Nine is dry.

shots.sfx: Paper settling flat, deep underground rumble, one distant rail-like metallic groan

shots.framing: Medium-wide rear three-quarter shot with all faces visible beside a black maintenance door
shots.background: Black maintenance door, yellow route stripe disappearing beneath it, wet green tiles and a pressure pipe entering the wall
poses: Nara faces the sealed door, Jun holds the transit overlay to her chest, and Soren watches the pressure pipe.
Nara steps closer, Jun glances toward Soren, and Soren rests one hand near the old latch.
Nara looks back at the others, Jun adjusts her headphones nervously, and Soren gives a reluctant nod.
Nara turns toward the door again, Jun squares her shoulders, and Soren raises his flashlight.
shots.narration: The trace ended at Bellwether's sealed subway door. Subscribe—we had to enter before the next pulse.
shots.sfx: Seventeen-second pressure удар, old latch trembling, water whispering behind tile
